description: The calendar filter component can be used as a date slicer and also display summarized and detailed data by date type. It is suitable for displaying reports of various industries that contain date-type data. This component categorizes and aggregates data into three modules: by year, by month, and by week, and also provides a quick filter for the current date. When selecting 'by year' and enabling aggregation, it displays the aggregated data by year and shows all selectable years. If aggregation is disabled, you can switch left and right to select a specific year, displaying the aggregated data of the 12 months within that year, and you can filter by month. When selecting 'by month' and enabling aggregation, you can switch left and right to choose the corresponding year to display the monthly aggregated data, showing only months with existing data. If aggregation is disabled, you can switch left and right through all months in the data, or use dropdown options to select the desired year and month to view detailed data for the selected month, and you can filter external data by specific dates. When viewing by week, you can switch left and right through the years in the data to view the weekly aggregated data for each year, and you can filter external data by selecting the corresponding date range.
